paite: Huchi in Israel upa khenkhatte ka kiang ah ahong pai ua, ka ma ah atu ua.
heading: Pathian In Milim Biak Mohpaih
english: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tungta, ka kiang ah;
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, hiai mite'n amilimte uh alungtang uah alalut ua, ama uah athulimlouhna pukna uh akoih uhi; kei ahon dong peuhmah ding ua hia?"
english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

paite: Huaiziak in amau houpih inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel inkuan a michih alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua athulimlouhna pukna koih a, zawlnei kiang a hong pai peuhmah, kei TOUPA'N amilim uh tamdan bang zel in ka dawng ding.
english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I Yahweh will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

paite: Israel inkote amilim uh ziak a hon na omtuamsan ziak ua alungtang ua ka mattheihna ding in."
english: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

paite: Huaiziak in Israel inkote kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hong kik unla, na milimte ua kipan in hong kik un, na kihhuaina tengteng uh lehngatsan un.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

paite: "Israel inkote lak a mi kuapeuh hiam, mikhual Israel gam a teng hiam, kei a kipan a kihihtuam, alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua thulimlouhna pukna koih kawm a, atungtang ua hon dong ding a zawlnei kiang a hoh kei leh TOUPA ngei in ka dawng ding hi.
english: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I Yahweh will answer him by myself.

paite: Huai mi ka masuan ding a, mi'n lamdang asak ding in tangtawn tangtawn a gen ding in ka mite lak a kipan ka hihmang ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uhi.
english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huan zawlnei khem a om in thu gen henla, kei TOUPA'N zawlnei ka thuzoh ahi a, atung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, ka mi Israelte lak a kipan ka hihmang ding.
english: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, Yahweh, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

paite: Athulimlouhna uh apo ding ua; zawlnei thulimlouhna amah dong mite thulimlouhna bang mai ahi ding hi.
english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

paite: Israel inkote kei a kipan aman nawn louh ua, atatleknate tengteng ua akihihnit nawn samlouhna ding un, ka mite ahih zawk ua a Pathian uh ka hihtheihna ding in, Toupa PATHIAN in achi, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Noah, Daniel Leh Job
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, gam mite'n tatlekna thilhih a, ka tung a thil hihkhial a, ke'n ka khut ka lik a, a-an uh, hinna bul ka hihsiat a, atung ua kial ka tunsak a, mi leh sate ka hon hihmanleh hiai mi thum,
english: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

paite: Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng hong om bang hileh, adiktatna un amau hinna kia a humbit ding ahi," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Gam sahangte a gam uh ka tuansuaksak a, gam ahihsiat ua, ahong kigawp a, gamsa ziak a kuamah paisuak ding a-om kei uleh,
english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

paite: hiai mi thumte om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding uh; amau kia hotdam in a-om ding ua, gam asegawp ding hi.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

paite: Ahihkeileh huai gam ah namsau ka lik dia, "Namsau aw, gamsung teng tawnsuak in," mi leh gamsa ka gawimang ding hi.
english: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

paite: Hiai mi thumte om le uh leng, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding ua, amau hinna kia humbit in a-om ding uh.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

paite: Ahihkeileh, huai gam ah, hipi ka hon lensak a, mi leh sa hihmang ding a sisan suah a ka hehna huai gam tung a ka hon sunleh;
english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

paite: Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng na om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanu uhiam, atapa uhiam ahumbit kei ding ua, adiktatna un amau hinna ngei ahumbit lel ding uhi.
english: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a, "Jerusalem tung a ka vaihawmna na mahmah lite, namsaute, kialte, gam sahangte, hipite, mi leh sa gawimang vek ding a ka hon tut hun chiang in bangzah a thupi ahi diam aw?
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

paite: Himahleh ngai in, huai lai a akhosuaksun pikhiak dingte nutsiat in a-om ding ua, tanute leh tapate leng; ngai un, akiang uah ahong pawtkhe ding ua, a-omdan uh athilhihte na mu ding uh, Jerusalem tung a thil hoih lou ka hon tut thu ah lungmuan in na om ding ua, atung a ka hon tut tengteng thu ah leng.
english: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

paite: A-omdan uleh athilhihte uh na muh hun chiang un ahon lungmuan ding uh; atung a ka thilhih tengteng hihsan nei lou in ka hih kei chih na thei ding uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord Yahweh.
